verdict.rationale: Convex's docs and community evidence confirm true reactive subscriptions: queries automatically re-run server-side when data dependencies change (via readset/writeset tracking), pushing updates to clients without polling, enabling real-time UI updates. This is corroborated by first-party docs and detailed technical explanation from Convex engineers on HN. missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmark or third-party reproduction of live-update latency/behavior beyond vendor and self-reported engineering explanation.
